newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Sterling/mark to probe support at 3.0360.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Sterling/mark to probe support at 3.0360.

text.p: The speed of sterling's surge to multi-year highs on Wednesday means there are few supports on the way down until 3.0360 marks, technical analysts said.
The pound leapt more than three pfennigs yesterday to trade as high as 3.0878 marks, its strongest since September 1989.
Initial support near 3.05 was under pressure in morning European trade. There are few strong props until 3.0360 and then 3.0330 which acted as resistances on the way up, analysts said.
"There could be a head and shoulders pattern forming and if this turns out to be the case, 3.05 marks is the neckline," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank.
